steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the main window is restored with space to grow within the desktop work area
the user moves the pointer onto the left edge of the main window
the pointer shows a horizontal resize cursor

the window grows along the horizontal axes of that handle
the opposite boundary stays fixed
the viewport and visible ribbon fit within the resized window
